questions.question: During a basic vehicle controls skills test, where should your vehicle's final position be?

options.text: In the general area the examiner described.
In the exact position the examiner described.
Within three feet of the position the examiner described.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the exact position the examiner described.
questions.explanation: You must finish each exercise with your vehicle in the exact position the examiner described. You can fail the basic control skills test if you do not complete exercises exactly as described.

questions.question: What should a school bus driver do while students are boarding?

options.text: Read a book.
Check all mirrors.
Only look at the students.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check all mirrors.
questions.explanation: While students board, watch all mirrors to see if any students are running to catch the bus.

questions.question: During a vehicle inspection test, which of these do you NOT need to do?

options.text: Show where the dipstick is located.
Show that the engine oil is within safe operating range.
Show that the oil is below the refill mark.

questions.correctAnswerText: Show that the oil is below the refill mark.
questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection test, you must show where the dipstick is located and that the oil level is within a safe operating range and above the refill mark.

questions.question: What can you NOT see with properly adjusted crossover mirrors?

options.text: The right and left front tires touching the ground.
The area in front of the bus.
The tops of the right and left rear tires.

questions.correctAnswerText: The tops of the right and left rear tires.
questions.explanation: Properly adjusted crossover mirrors show the area in front of the bus from the front bumper to where you can see directly. They also show the right and left front tires touching the ground and the area from the front of the bus to the service door.

questions.question: How should you complete a conventional parallel parking maneuver?

options.text: Back up past the parking space, then pull forward into it.
Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it.
Pull forward directly into the parking space.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it.
questions.explanation: Drive past the parking space on the right, then back into it. Get the rear of your vehicle as close to the rear of the space as possible. Your vehicle must be completely within the boundaries of the space.

questions.question: When students are being picked up by a school bus, what should happen?

options.text: The students should wait at a designated bus stop.
The driver should stop to pick up students who are walking to a designated bus stop.
The parents may choose where the bus stops are located.

questions.correctAnswerText: The students should wait at a designated bus stop.
questions.explanation: School bus drivers can only pick up students at official stops that are designated by school officials.

questions.question: If you are stopped at a railroad crossing while driving a school bus, what should you do?

options.text: Prepare to proceed as soon as a train passes.
Ignore signs and signals.
Open the door to listen for approaching trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Open the door to listen for approaching trains.
questions.explanation: Do not rely only on signals. Tell passengers to be quiet, open the front door, and look and listen for trains. After a train passes, check for trains coming from either direction before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: When exiting a vehicle, what should a driver do?

options.text: Hop directly from their seat to the ground.
Maintain at least one point of contact with their vehicle.
Be turned to face their vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be turned to face their vehicle.
questions.explanation: You must face the vehicle and maintain three points of contact at all times when exiting. If driving a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly may result in automatic failure of the basic vehicle control skills test.

questions.question: When should mirrors be adjusted on a school bus?

options.text: During the drive.
Before beginning to drive.
By the students.

questions.correctAnswerText: Before beginning to drive.
questions.explanation: Always check and adjust all mirrors before you start operating a school bus.

questions.question: What is true about loading and unloading a bus?

options.text: It can be hazardous for passengers.
It does not need to be supervised.
It should be done while refueling.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can be hazardous for passengers.
questions.explanation: More students are killed during loading or unloading of school buses than while riding them. School bus drivers must follow proper safety procedures during loading and unloading.

questions.question: When making a turn during your driving test, you should:

options.text: Use your turn signal only if other cars are nearby.
Check traffic only in the direction you are turning.
Check traffic in all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check traffic in all directions.
questions.explanation: When making a turn during your driving test, you must check traffic in all directions and use your turn signal.

questions.question: When stopping to pick up students, park at least 10 feet away from them because:

options.text: You can see their movements clearly.
You cannot get any closer to the students.
Students need to walk for exercise.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can see their movements clearly.
questions.explanation: Park with the front bumper at least 10 feet away from students. This is the safest option because it lets you watch the students as they walk to the bus.

questions.question: When loading or unloading passengers, put the school bus in ____ if there is no park position available.

options.text: Reverse
First gear
Neutral

questions.correctAnswerText: Neutral
questions.explanation: When loading or unloading students, put the bus in park if possible. If park is not available, put the bus in neutral and set the parking brake.

questions.question: Except for the straight line backing exercise, you may exit your vehicle to check its position during a test up to:

options.text: One time.
Two times.
Three times.

questions.correctAnswerText: Two times.
questions.explanation: You can exit your vehicle to check its position during a test. You may do this only once during straight line backing. You may do this up to two times during any other exercise.

questions.question: The overhead rearview mirror is located:

options.text: On the right side of the bus.
On the steering wheel of the bus.
Above the windshield inside the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead inside rearview mirror is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side. Use this mirror to watch students inside the bus.

questions.question: If a railroad crossing gate does not go back up after a train passes, you should:

options.text: Drive around the gate.
Wait for another vehicle to cross first to see if it is safe.
Call your dispatcher.

questions.correctAnswerText: Call your dispatcher.
questions.explanation: If the gate stays down after a train passes, call your dispatcher. Do not drive around the lowered gate.

questions.question: ABS helps you:

options.text: Lock up your wheels.
Keep your wheels from locking up.
Count the number of students boarding the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your wheels from locking up.
questions.explanation: Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) prevents your wheels from locking up when you brake hard on a slippery surface.

questions.question: The inside rearview mirror is used to:

options.text: See passengers.
See potential hazards on the road.
See vehicles trying to switch lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: See passengers.
questions.explanation: The overhead inside rearview mirror is used to watch what students are doing inside the bus.

questions.question: If you must back up at a student pick-up point, you should:

options.text: Back up before the students board the bus.
Back up after the students board the bus.
Back up while students direct you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Back up after the students board the bus.
questions.explanation: Backing up in a school bus is dangerous and should be avoided. If you must back up at a pick-up point, wait until all students have boarded first.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you must be able to do all of the following, except:

options.text: Show where the power steering fluid dipstick is located.
Check that there is enough power steering fluid.
Ensure the power steering fluid level is above the full mark.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ensure the power steering fluid level is above the full mark.
questions.explanation: During the vehicle inspection test, show where the power steering fluid dipstick is located and check that the fluid is at a safe level. The fluid should not go above the full mark.
